questions.question: What is the primary goal of AI ethics?
options: To ensure AI is developed and used responsibly, fairly and safely.
To reduce the cost of computers.

questions.question: Which of the following should generally NOT be shared with an AI platform unless you fully understand how it will be handled?
What is AI bias?
options: When AI always agrees with the user.
When AI produces unfair or unbalanced results because of limitations in data or design.
When AI answers every question perfectly.

questions.question: What is misinformation?
options: Verified information published by official organizations.
Information that is false or inaccurate.

questions.question: An AI hallucination occurs when AI:
options: Creates convincing but incorrect or fabricated information.

questions.question: Why should important AI-generated information be verified?
options: Because AI can sometimes produce inaccurate or outdated information.
Because AI always copies from books.

questions.question: What is plagiarism?
options: Presenting someone else's work or ideas as your own without proper acknowledgment.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects responsible AI use in education?
options: Use AI to complete examinations for you.
Use AI as a learning assistant while developing your own understanding.
Copy every AI response directly into assignments.
Allow AI to replace studying completely.

questions.question: Which human skill will remain valuable even as AI continues to advance?
Why is lifelong learning important in the age of AI?
options: Because AI technology and workplace requirements continue to evolve.
Because learning ends after one course.
Because AI will eventually stop improving.
